# AeroInfo — Airport Security Rules, 3D Scanners & Passenger Logistics

> AeroInfo (https://www.aero-info.eu) provides verified, up-to-date security screening rules, EDS-CB C3 3D scanner status, liquid allowances, powerbank regulations, and terminal logistics for commercial airports across Italy, Europe, and major international hubs.

## Overview & Core Principles

- **3D Scanners (EDS-CB C3):** At airports equipped with approved next-generation 3D computed tomography (CT) scanners (such as Rome Fiumicino FCO, Milan Malpensa MXP, Milan Linate LIN, Prague PRG T2, Dublin DUB), passengers may leave liquids, toiletries, and electronics (laptops/tablets) inside their cabin bags. Note that individual airport limits (e.g., up to 2 litres vs standard limits) are subject to current European and national aviation regulations.
- **Standard Checkpoints (Non-C3):** At airports with conventional screening (e.g. Naples NAP, Palermo PMO, Catania CTA, Paris Beauvais BVA), the EU standard 100 ml rule applies: all liquids, gels, creams, and aerosols must be in containers of max 100 ml, stored inside a single transparent resealable 1-litre plastic bag, and extracted during screening.
- **Powerbanks & Spare Lithium Batteries:** Under international ICAO/EASA regulations, powerbanks and spare lithium batteries are strictly permitted **in carry-on luggage only**. They are **strictly forbidden** in checked hold luggage due to fire safety hazards.
- **Transit Caution:** Travelers flying from a 3D scanner airport to or through a standard airport must adhere to the strictest rule of any transit or return airport on their itinerary.

## Comprehensive Guides & Comparative Hubs

- [Elenco Aeroporti con Scanner 3D C3 (Italian)](https://www.aero-info.eu/scanner-3d-aeroporti): Mappa e lista completa degli aeroporti con scanner tomografici 3D operativi in Italia ed Europa, regole liquidi e avviso sul volo di ritorno.
- [3D Airport Scanners Directory (English)](https://www.aero-info.eu/en/3d-scanners-airports): Complete directory of airports with next-gen 3D CT scanners, liquid allowances, and transfer guidelines.
- [Guida Liquidi Bagaglio a Mano (Italian)](https://www.aero-info.eu/guide/liquidi-bagaglio-a-mano): Regole generali UE sui liquidi, eccezioni per scanner 3D C3, medicinali, alimenti per neonati e checklist pre-partenza.
- [Liquids in Carry-On Baggage Guide (English)](https://www.aero-info.eu/en/guides/liquids-in-carry-on-baggage): General EU liquid rules, 3D scanner exceptions, medicines, baby food, and transfer advice.

## Key Italian Airport Profiles

- [Roma Fiumicino (FCO)](https://www.aero-info.eu/aeroporti/aeroporto-internazionale-leonardo-da-vinci-fiumicino-fco): Scanner 3D C3 attivi al T1 e T3, liquidi e PC possono rimanere nel bagaglio.
- [Milano Malpensa (MXP)](https://www.aero-info.eu/aeroporti/aeroporto-di-milano-malpensa-mxp): Scanner 3D C3 attivi al Terminal 1.
- [Milano Linate (LIN)](https://www.aero-info.eu/aeroporti/aeroporto-di-milano-linate-enrico-forlanini-lin): Scanner 3D C3 su tutte le linee di sicurezza.
- [Bergamo Orio al Serio (BGY)](https://www.aero-info.eu/aeroporti/aeroporto-di-milano-bergamo-orio-al-serio-il-caravaggio-bgy): Scanner 3D C3 attivi sui varchi principali.
- [Bologna Guglielmo Marconi (BLQ)](https://www.aero-info.eu/aeroporti/aeroporto-di-bologna-guglielmo-marconi-blq): Scanner 3D C3 attivi.
- [Venezia Marco Polo (VCE)](https://www.aero-info.eu/aeroporti/aeroporto-di-venezia-marco-polo-vce): Scanner 3D C3 operativi.
- [Napoli Capodichino (NAP)](https://www.aero-info.eu/aeroporti/aeroporto-internazionale-di-napoli-capodichino-nap): Regola standard 100 ml, estrazione liquidi e PC obbligatoria.
- [Catania Fontanarossa (CTA)](https://www.aero-info.eu/aeroporti/aeroporto-di-catania-fontanarossa-vincenzo-bellini-cta): Regola standard 100 ml.
- [Palermo Falcone Borsellino (PMO)](https://www.aero-info.eu/aeroporti/aeroporto-di-palermo-falcone-e-borsellino-pmo): Regola standard 100 ml.
- [Bari Karol Wojtyla (BRI)](https://www.aero-info.eu/aeroporti/aeroporto-di-bari-karol-wojty-a-bri): Regola standard 100 ml.
- [Pisa Galileo Galilei (PSA)](https://www.aero-info.eu/aeroporti/aeroporto-di-pisa-galileo-galilei-psa): Regola standard 100 ml.
- [Roma Ciampino (CIA)](https://www.aero-info.eu/aeroporti/aeroporto-di-roma-ciampino-g-b-pastine-cia): Regola standard 100 ml.

## Key International Airport Profiles

- [London Heathrow (LHR)](https://www.aero-info.eu/en/airports/london-heathrow-airport-lhr): UK security policy, next-gen CT rollout in progress.
- [London Gatwick (LGW)](https://www.aero-info.eu/en/airports/london-gatwick-airport-lgw): South and North terminal security checkpoints.
- [Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG)](https://www.aero-info.eu/en/airports/paris-charles-de-gaulle-airport-cdg): Terminal-specific checkpoints and transfer guidance.
- [Frankfurt Airport (FRA)](https://www.aero-info.eu/en/airports/frankfurt-airport-fra): Terminal 1 & 2 security screening policies.
- [Amsterdam Schiphol (AMS)](https://www.aero-info.eu/en/airports/amsterdam-airport-schiphol-ams): CT security lanes active, liquids in bag.
- [Madrid Barajas (MAD)](https://www.aero-info.eu/en/airports/adolfo-suarez-madrid-barajas-airport-mad): Aena security regulations.
- [Barcelona El Prat (BCN)](https://www.aero-info.eu/en/airports/josep-tarradellas-barcelona-el-prat-airport-bcn): T1 and T2 screening procedures.
- [Prague Václav Havel (PRG)](https://www.aero-info.eu/en/airports/vaclav-havel-airport-prague-prg): Terminal 2 3D CT scanners (Schengen) vs Terminal 1 (Non-Schengen).
- [Dublin Airport (DUB)](https://www.aero-info.eu/en/airports/dublin-airport-dub): C3 scanners operational across T1 and T2.
- [Berlin Brandenburg (BER)](https://www.aero-info.eu/en/airports/berlin-brandenburg-airport-willy-brandt-ber): T1 lanes 1 & 5 and T2 next-generation screening.
